translations.web: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
translations.bsb: I know that everything God does endures forever; nothing can be added to it or taken from it. God does it so that they should fear Him.
